item.title: Jesse Jackson's most memorable visits to Connecticut, including a 2003 arrest
item.description: People around the world are mourning the passing of Rev. Jesse Jackson. Jackson came to Connecticut dozens of times over the years. Maybe the most memorable visit was when he got arrested as part of a protest by unionized Yale workers in 2003.

item.title: Report finds 'significant gaps' in child care in Connecticut following sexual assault investigation
item.description: An investigation conducted following the arrest of a Bethany Parks and Recreation employee accused of sexually assaulting multiple children found "significant gaps" in license-exempt child care settings and youth camps that put children at risk of harm, according to Connecticut's Office of the Child Advocate (OCA).
